```python
def format_long_text(text: str, color: str='', columns: int=
    get_terminal_size().columns, start_line_decorator: str=' ',
    end_line_decorator: str=' ', max_lines: Optional[int]=None, styling:
    Optional[Dict[str, Any]]=None, indent: str='', sub_indent: str='') ->str:
    if not text:
        return start_line_decorator + end_line_decorator

    # Calculate available width for text
    # The line will be: start_line_decorator + indent + text_content + end_line_decorator
    first_line_prefix = start_line_decorator + indent
    subsequent_line_prefix = start_line_decorator + sub_indent

    first_line_width = columns - len(click.unstyle(first_line_prefix)) - len(end_line_decorator)
    subsequent_line_width = columns - len(click.unstyle(subsequent_line_prefix)) - len(end_line_decorator)

    if first_line_width <= 0:
        first_line_width = 1
    if subsequent_line_width <= 0:
        subsequent_line_width = 1

    # Unstyle text for wrapping purposes
    raw_text = click.unstyle(text)

    # Wrap the text
    wrapper = textwrap.TextWrapper(
        width=first_line_width,
        subsequent_indent='',
        break_long_words=False,
        break_on_hyphens=False
    )

    first_lines = wrapper.wrap(raw_text)

    if not first_lines:
        first_lines = ['']

    # Re-wrap subsequent lines with subsequent width if different
    all_lines = []
    if first_lines:
        all_lines.append(first_lines[0])
        
        # Re-wrap remaining text with subsequent width
        remaining_text = raw_text[len(first_lines[0]):].strip()
        if remaining_text:
            sub_wrapper = textwrap.TextWrapper(
                width=subsequent_line_width,
                break_long_words=False,
                break_on_hyphens=False
            )
            sub_lines = sub_wrapper.wrap(remaining_text)
            all_lines.extend(sub_lines)

    if max_lines is not None:
        all_lines = all_lines[:max_lines]

    result_lines = []
    for i, line in enumerate(all_lines):
        if i == 0:
            prefix = first_line_prefix
        else:
            prefix = subsequent_line_prefix
        
        formatted_line = prefix + line + end_line_decorator
        result_lines.append(formatted_line)

    result = '\n'.join(result_lines)

    if color:
        result = click.style(result, fg=color)

    if styling:
        result = click.style(result, **styling)

    return result
```
